tools_used.command: /bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba classes/range.js; cat package.json; rg --files classes internal functions ranges test/classes; rg -n 'Range|includePrerelease|loose|intersects|subset' README.md | head -65"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '149,220p' README.md; sed -n '280,382p' README.md; sed -n '417,438p' README.md; sed -n '495,534p' README.md; nl -ba classes/comparator.js; nl -ba internal/parse-options.js; nl -ba internal/lrucache.js; nl -ba test/classes/range.js; rg -n 'BUILD|GTE0|CARET|TILDE|XRANGE|HYPHEN' internal/re.js; cat ranges/intersects.js functions/satisfies.js; rg --files -g '.logic-lens.yaml' -g '*range*' -g '*intersect*' test"

/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba classes/semver.js | sed -n '1,180p'; nl -ba internal/re.js | sed -n '1,60p;90,162p;195,225p'; nl -ba test/fixtures/range-intersection.js; rg -n '\\+|includePrerelease|\\|\\||00\\.' test/fixtures/range-parse.js test/fixtures/range-include.js test/fixtures/range-exclude.js | head -120; nl -ba ranges/min-version.js; cat internal/debug.js internal/constants.js"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '136,149p' README.md; sed -n '450,462p' README.md; rg -n 'build metadata|Build metadata|precedence|\\+build' README.md test/classes/semver.js test/fixtures/comparator-intersection.js; rg --files --hidden -g '.logic-lens.yaml' -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.git/**'"' ."

/bin/zsh -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c 'import pathlib, subprocess, sys; result = subprocess.run([\"node\", \"range-review.cjs\"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10); output = result.stdout + result.stderr; pathlib.Path(\"range-review-results.txt\").write_text(output); print(output, end=\"\"); sys.exit(result.returncode)'"
